These are explicitly fictional, deterministic Slice 3 fixtures. They are not real openings or the builder's profile. Their clock is frozen at 12 October 2026. The matching outputs are controlled test doubles, not claims about a live AI response. The raw texts provide reusable demo inputs; matching/decision acceptance runs against the structured validated facts.

The pack covers the guide's required Slice 3 scenarios (1–4 and 7), plus missing profile facts, conflicting sources, experience, same-day deadlines, weak fit and junk. Duplicate ingestion and non-opportunity rejection also have separate integration tests. Approval, expiry, replay, ownership and action-recovery checks are in scripts and supabase/tests; their current live evidence is recorded in docs/progress.md. Standing rules remain an event addition and PDF input remains deferred.

The demo seeder validates fifteen extraction test doubles against their labelled raw announcements and saves source provenance into an isolated fictional account. It queues the actual matching workflow instead of inserting expected decisions, completed actions or healthy heartbeats. One common fictional profile is used for that account, so live decisions need not match the per-case unit-test profiles. Seeded extraction is explicitly simulated; it does not establish a successful live AI call. Cleanup requires the exact fictional account UUID and its matching example.invalid address and refuses a human account.
